label: Diagram 1.2
caption: Diagram 1.2 Minimum door width, hall widths and localised obstructions
description: This is a plan (top view) of a horizontal hall or corridor with door openings on either side, drawn as wall lines with quarter‑circle arcs showing the swing of each door. From left to right: a door arc is dimensioned 775mm across its opening; the hall on this side is marked 900mm and, at a wider point, 1050mm, with a horizontal double‑arrow labelled 2m max., a dashed rectangle (the key's "Permitted obstruction") and a grey shaded rectangle (the key's "Localised obstruction not permitted in shaded zone") placed in the hall. A lower door arc carries a 750mm vertical dimension and a 1200mm horizontal dimension. In the centre, a door arc is dimensioned 800mm. On the right, the hall is marked 750mm and 900mm, again with a horizontal 2m max. arrow, a grey shaded rectangle and a dashed rectangle in the hall; a far‑right door arc is dimensioned 750mm. A key at lower right shows the grey rectangle as "Localised obstruction not permitted in shaded zone" and the dashed rectangle as "Permitted obstruction", with the note "*all dimensions are minimum except where noted". A green banner at the bottom reads "Diagram 1.2 Minimum door width, hall widths and localised obstructions".
